proposed.text: How does RA 9514 connect sprinkler water flow to alarm initiation?

options.text: Water flow equal to or greater than flow from a single automatic sprinkler operates an alarm initiation device.
Water flow is never connected to alarms.
Water flow only affects plumbing records.
Water flow silences all notification devices.
